  "summary": "Coagulant day tank level LIT-202 is falling fast, currently at 32.7% with a range down to 32.7% and a 30-minute change of -10.5%.     "Bulk container or IBC empty; a chemical delivery missed or late",

    "Read the sight glass and compare it with the level transmitter",

    "Estimate the time to empty from the current level and the dosing rate"
